nodes.title: Note: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Model Links (for Local Users)

- Original model repo: [microsoft/Lens](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Lens)
- ComfyUI packaged repo: [Comfy-Org/Lens](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lens)

**vae**

- [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lens/resolve/main/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [gpt_oss_20b_nvfp4.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lens/resolve/main/text_encoders/gpt_oss_20b_nvfp4.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [lens_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lens/resolve/main/diffusion_models/lens_bf16.safetensors)
- [lens_turbo_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lens/resolve/main/diffusion_models/lens_turbo_bf16.safetensors)

Note: The turbo version does not seem to work with the negative prompt.

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── flux2-vae.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── gpt_oss_20b_nvfp4.safetensors
│   └── 📂 diffusion_models/
│       ├── lens_bf16.safetensors
│       └── lens_turbo_bf16.safetensors
```
